name: parallax-scroll-2
title: Rotated Parallax Grid
blurb: Rotating parallax grid with Y/X offset and 3D rotation on scroll.
description: A 3-column image grid with advanced parallax combining Y/X translation and rotateZ transforms per column. Effects are driven by scroll progress via motion/react useTransform.
use_when: High-impact galleries or portfolio sections where rotated parallax creates dramatic visual depth and engagement.
avoid_when: Motion-sensitive or vestibular-affected users; complex rotation + parallax combined can cause significant discomfort.
a11y: Complex scroll-driven transform chain; no prefers-reduced-motion support; high risk for vestibular disorders.
